notes: Targets are provisional engineering thresholds derived from recorded replay output and the July 30 seat test that found the v1.8.5 parked-hot and calm-flight rotor layers imperceptible.
Each sustained rotor harmonic must clear its own minimum; adding several sub-threshold layers is not accepted as tactile presence.
A profile cannot be promoted on replay KPIs alone; it also requires a structured seat test.
The hot-ground rotor goal is intentionally above the current baseline because insufficient ground rotor presence is a known complaint.
